//: Known first-appearance dates for entries that predate the 30-day window scripts/generate-removed.js reads. That window cannot see anything older, so an old entry whose line is rewritten, whose URL changes, or that is re-listed on a second page would otherwise be treated as new. Add a line here when that happens. Keys are "<page>|<normalized url>", with page the file name under docs/ (mobile.md). The date is when the entry first appeared on the wiki. Where the exact day is not worth chasing, use a date that is already older than the badge window (more than seven days ago) on which the entry is known to have been listed; a verified snapshot date is fine, and the badge only needs the date to be old. The generated new-sites.json still wins for anything inside the window, so this file can only ever make an entry look older, never newer. Keys without "|" are ignored, which is what this comment line is. Keep the file small: only add an entry when the badge is visibly wrong.
